description.value: Kelly's Go Karts has been a summertime fixture in Sicamous, BC since 1987, offering a 1,000-foot track with a scenic mountain backdrop just off Highway 1 near Shuswap Lake. Family-owned and operated, the venue runs double-seater karts for adults with children, kid-friendly karts, and adult karts reaching 15–25 km/h. It is a walk-up, first-come-first-served venue with free on-site parking, making it a casual roadside stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap corridor.
